But there may be multiple academic years in frpm (2014-2015 only? actually frpm has only one year in BIRD... let me check). Let's check distinct academic years first, then compute.

Also careful: the ratio "eligible free rate" = Free Meal Count (K-12) / Enrollment (K-12). The question asks for "the eligible free rate of the 10th and 11th schools" — probably two values.
